brief:
James "Fergie" Chambers, recently released on bail, rejected accusations that he supports Hamas, Al Jazeera English reported. The activist claimed he is being prosecuted for his opposition to war rather than any genuine security threat, characterizing the government's case as an attempt to criminalize antiwar activism.

Chambers maintained that his public advocacy centers on Palestinian rights and opposition to military conflict, not support for designated terrorist organizations. He framed his legal jeopardy as part of a broader effort to suppress dissent and rebrand political opposition to US military policy as extremism.
dek: Recently bailed activist denies accusations of supporting Hamas, claiming he is being punished for supporting Palestine.
title: US activist denies Hamas support, says he faces charges for antiwar views
